leave_warning_surface_label: Example leave-page warning posture for official voter information

reviewed_routes.loss_scope_note: Leaving before final submit can discard unsent step data unless the user saves a local draft first.
reviewed_routes.saved_state_boundary_note: Local draft and office-submitted states are labeled separately and never share the same confirmation copy.

reviewed_routes.loss_scope_note: Closing before upload confirmation can discard the selected file and unsent explanation text.
reviewed_routes.saved_state_boundary_note: The modal says explicitly that the office has not yet received the cure packet until the confirmation page appears.

browser_dialog_truthfulness_note: Any browser-generated leave confirmation is treated as a generic last-resort warning, not as a guaranteed or richly descriptive save surface.
custom_confirmation_note: Route-defined confirmations name what will be lost and use explicit Continue without saving vs Go back style choices when a custom modal is used.
saved_state_boundary_note: Unsaved, local-draft, queued, and office-acknowledged states are reviewed as distinct public meanings on covered routes.
mobile_or_hidden_state_note: The office does not assume a last-second leave dialog will always appear on mobile or app-switch paths and reviews earlier preservation posture accordingly.
recovery_route_note: If the user leaves or cancels, the route preserves a bounded restart or help path to the current official page/help lane.
